criticalConclusions.statement: The 25 failed probes include observed service mutations and four canonical entity conflicts.
criticalConclusions.requiredAction: Resolve canonical conflicts and approved policies before correction runs.
criticalConclusions.consequence: Changing alert waits alone will not resolve the failed behaviors.

scope.inspection: Read-only retained evidence triage. No source changes, fixtures, databases, or reruns.
